turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - nlo_dn_train.csv: 200 crystalline materials, columns `formula`, `poscar`
    (the crystal structure, in POSCAR format) and `dn` (the birefringence at
    1064 nm, dimensionless).
  - nlo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose properties are
    NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar` (the crystal
    structure, in POSCAR format).

Using the training data, predict which candidates have the HIGHEST
birefringence at 1064 nm, then select the 5 best candidates from the pool.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
# Analysis

Looking at the training data, the compounds with the **highest birefringence** share clear structural/chemical signatures:

| Compound | dn | Key feature |
|---|---|---|
| Tl8Te12 | 1.50 | Tl⁺ lone pair + extended polytelluride network |
| Cs4Cu4Se16 | 1.16 | Se–Se polyselenide chains |
| Cs8Sb8 | 1.14 | Sb8 Zintl-anion rings (Sb³⁺ lone pairs) |
| Na4In4Sn8 | 0.97 | Zintl post-transition-metal network |
| Rb8Sb8 | 0.95 | Sb8 Zintl-anion rings |
| Li(Ge)(Sb)Te3 | 0.74 | Lone-pair layered chalcogenide |
| Ba2Te6 | 0.46 | Te6 polytelluride rings |
| BiTeBr | 0.47 | Lone-pair layered chalcohalide |

The pattern is unmistakable: **strongly anisotropic, low-symmetry structures built from (i) alkali-metal Zintl clusters of heavy pnictogens (As/Sb/Bi), (ii) chalcogen–chalcogen (poly-chalcogenide) chains/rings, or (iii) stereochemically active lone-pair cations (Tl⁺, Sb³⁺, Bi³⁺, Pb²⁺, Te⁴⁺)** — as opposed to simple close-packed tetrahedral semiconductors (which give dn < 0.15 almost universally in this dataset).

Scanning the candidate pool for these same fingerprints:

- **c007 (Rb8As8)** – isostructural/isoelectronic Zintl analog of the very-high-dn Cs8Sb8/Rb8Sb8 compounds (same As/Sb pnictogen family, ring/cluster anion).
- **c089 (Cs8Se12)** – alkali polyselenide with Se–Se ring bonding, directly analogous to the top-performing Cs4Cu4Se16 and Ba2Te6 polychalcogenides.
- **c061 (Cs8S12)** – polysulfide ring analog of the same family (lighter chalcogen, expected somewhat lower than Se/Te analogs but still highly anisotropic).
- **c064 (Tl8S20)** – Tl⁺ lone-pair cation with extended polysulfide network, structurally analogous to the champion Tl8Te12.
- **c074 (Tl2Sb2P4Se12)** – combines two lone-pair-active cations (Tl⁺, Sb³⁺) with a Se-rich anionic framework, similar to Cs4Hg4Sb4Se12 and Rb2Nb4P2Se20 in the training set (both moderately/highly birefringent).

These five candidates most closely mirror the structural motifs responsible for the largest birefringence values in the training set.

Final: c007, c089, c061, c064, c074
